summary: Built the point-to-point chain node3 -- node1(VyOS) -- node2(OPNsense) -- node4, configured node1 to permit+log tcp/23 traffic from node3 toward node4 and node2 to refuse+log the same flow, and verified a single connection attempt from node3 produces a matching permit/refuse log pair on node1 and node2 (identical source/dest IP, port, and IP ID, same timestamp). Then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, proving changed boot identity and full recovery of interfaces, routes, and firewall config, and re-verified the same permit/refuse behavior and log pairing after all reboots.
actions_performed: Discovered actual physical wiring via ARP/tcpdump probing (node3.eth1<->node1.eth2, node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1, node2.vtnet2<->node4.eth1), correcting an initial wrong assumption

Assigned static /30 addresses on all link interfaces: node3 eth1=10.10.12.1, node1 eth2=10.10.12.2, node1 eth1=10.10.23.1, node2 vtnet1(opt1)=10.10.23.2, node2 vtnet2(opt2)=10.10.34.1, node4 eth1=10.10.34.2 via nmcli (node3/node4), VyOS set commands (node1), and OPNsense config.xml (node2)
Added static routes so node3<->node4 traffic transits node1 then node2 in both directions

Configured VyOS node1 firewall: forward filter default-action drop, rule 5 accept established/related, rule 10 accept+log tcp destination port 23 inbound on eth2 (node3 side) outbound on eth1 (node2 side); committed and saved

Configured OPNsense node2 via config.xml: assigned opt1/opt2 interfaces, added a block+log filter rule for tcp/23 inbound on opt1 (the node1-facing link); applied with configctl interface reconfigure, configctl routes configure, configctl filter reload
Started an ncat listener on node4:23 (10.10.34.2) to give the flow a real telnet-port destination

Ran a single nc connection attempt from node3 to 10.10.34.2:23, confirmed it timed out (refused), and pulled the matching node1 permit-log line and node2 block-log line for that exact packet (same src/dst IP, ports, IP ID, timestamp)
Captured pre-restart boot identity (boot_id / kern.boottime) and health/config baselines for all four nodes
Restarted node3 (systemctl reboot, backgrounded for ack-then-disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and recovered eth1 IP/route
Restarted node4 similarly, confirmed changed boot_id and recovered eth1 IP/route, restarted the ncat listener
Restarted node1 via /sbin/reboot (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and that the full firewall/interface config persisted via `save`

Restarted node2 via `configctl system reboot` (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed changed kern.boottime and that opt1/opt2 IPs, static route, and the block+log pf rule all persisted from config.xml
Re-ran the node3->node4 telnet attempt after all four restarts and re-captured the matching permit (node1) / block (node2) log pair, proving the whole chain's behavior survived the restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 permits node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic and records it
evidence.summary: VyOS forward filter rule 10 (accept, log, inbound eth2/outbound eth1, tcp dport 23) committed and saved; show log firewall shows ACCEPT entries [ipv4-FWD-filter-10-A] for SRC=10.10.12.1 DST=10.10.34.2 DPT=23 SYN packets

evidence.requirement: node2 refuses node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic and records the refusal
evidence.summary: OPNsense config.xml block+log rule added for tcp/23 on opt1 (vtnet1); pfctl -sr confirms 'block drop in log quick on vtnet1 inet proto tcp ... port = telnet'; filter log shows matching block entries for the same flow

evidence.requirement: Single attempt from node3 produces a matching permit/refuse log pair showing where traffic stopped
evidence.summary: One nc attempt (2026-09-06T04:29:22Z) timed out; node1 log shows ACCEPT+log for IP ID=26369 SPT=52186 DPT=23 SRC=10.10.12.1 DST=10.10.34.2 at 00:29:22 local; node2 log shows block for the identical packet (same IP ID, ports, TCP ISN 2246665030) at 04:29:22 UTC, proving node1 passed it and node2 stopped it

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2eb8b6e8...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 1050868a... (changed); show configuration commands confirms eth1/eth2 addresses and firewall rule 10 (permit+log) persisted

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime 04:22:28; configctl system reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-reboot kern.boottime 04:31:24 (changed); ifconfig/netstat/pfctl confirm opt1/opt2 IPs, static route to 10.10.12.0/30, and the block+log telnet rule all persisted

evidence.requirement: node3 (AlmaLinux) baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 82d4f0d1...; systemctl reboot backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 78be608e... (changed); eth1 IP and static route to 10.10.34.0/30 confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node4 (AlmaLinux) baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 54089086...; systemctl reboot backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 04dcdd0f... (changed); eth1 IP, static route, and re-started ncat:23 listener confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: End-to-end behavior and log pairing survives all four node restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart nc attempt from node3 to 10.10.34.2:23 timed out; node1 log shows ACCEPT+log for IP ID=39799 SPT=60700 DPT=23 at 04:31:37; node2 log shows block for the identical packet (same IP ID, ports, ISN 3989428445) at the same timestamp, confirming the permit-then-refuse behavior and its log evidence are intact after all restarts
